releaseTitle: ATalk v3.4.8 — Authentic Telegram Polish, Anchored Popups, Cover Notification Disguise & Fluid Chat UX
releaseNotes:
• Anchored Context Menu: Single tap opens the popup dynamically adjacent to the message with a dimmed focus scrim.
• Verified Shield Removed: Removed the blue verified checkmark icon next to contact usernames in the top bar.
• 100% Notes Cover Notification: Persistent foreground service notification now displays 'Notes Cloud Sync: All notes up to date' matching the Notes app disguise.
• Interactive Reaction Pills: Direct-on-bubble reactions with cyan glow when reacted, tap-to-toggle, and animated numeric tickers.
• Double-Tap Quick React: Double-tap sends ❤️ with radiating starburst particles and acoustic feedback.
• Floating Scroll-To-Bottom: Reading history is never interrupted; downward button with unread counter (+1, +2) glides to latest messages.
• Continuous Drag-to-Select: Long-press and drag up/down with automatic edge viewport scrolling.
